vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-27171
vulnerability.description: zlib: crc32_combine64()/x2nmodp() never terminate for a negative len2

statements.status_notes: Fixed by a version bump: zlib1g 1:1.4-0+echo1 is upstream zlib 1.4 built from the signed release tarball (build/build-zlib.sh, pins in build/versions.env); 1.4 returns 0 for len2 < 0. Scanners still match the Debian tracker entry for source package 'zlib', which has no fixed version, so every version is flagged. Evidence from the image itself: vex/evidence.txt (nginx maps libz.so.1.4; crc32_combine(len2=-1) returns 0, 1.2.13 loops forever).

vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-23419
vulnerability.description: nginx: TLS 1.3 session resumption across SNI virtual servers bypasses client certificate authentication

statements.status_notes: Fixed by backporting upstream commit 13935cf9fdc3c8d8278c70716417d3b71c36140e (released in 1.27.4/1.26.3) unmodified onto 1.25.5: build/patches/CVE-2025-23419.patch, applied with --fuzz=0 by build/build-nginx.sh. The version string stays 1.25.5, so version-based matching (CPE) still reports it. Evidence from the image itself: vex/evidence.txt (/usr/sbin/nginx and nginx-debug reference SSL_SESSION_get0_hostname, the function the fix adds; the original binaries do not).
